newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich airport Jan-June 97 cargo traffic up 6.9pct.
newsitem.headline: Zurich airport Jan-June 97 cargo traffic up 6.9pct.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich Airport in January-June 1997 was up 6.9 percent on the same period last year at 230,951 tonnes, airport authority figures show.

Cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at Zurich in the first six months of the year increased by 4.7 percent on 1996 levels to 125,358 tonnes while foreign carriers' volume was up 3.5 percent to 39,382 tonnes.
Trucked airfreight handled at Zurich airport grew by 13.8 percent on Jan-Jun 1996 to 66,211 tonnes.
Jan-Jun '97 postal traffic totalled 9,643 tonnes, up 19.2 percent on the same period in 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
